payload.text: (vc, 2026-11-19 09:53Z by date -u, under hv decision 67) HOW ST0095's AND ISSUE 0705's HIGHLANDER CHECK RUNS. (1) EXISTING CODE: an independent sweep of every place the tree mints, reads, formats, orders, validates or scans an id, or reads or writes .intentfiles or the two aggregate views, in every language, run now by three read-only reviewers vc launched (intentsvcs; the other crates and every test; everything that is not Rust), and given none of the seats' censuses. vc compares it with the censuses and sends each finding to the seat whose package owns it, which adds it to that package's scope. The reports are banked under refs/bank/vc/st0095/highlander-*. (2) EVERY CHANGE: each unit's proof carries a critic-<lang> review of its diff for every language the diff touches, with each Highlander finding fixed or answered, and vc reads it against the diff before saying land. From WP-04 on, a unit that handles an id does so through intentsvcs::id and says so. (3) AT THE CLOSE: the same sweep runs again over the whole tree and must find one home for every concern. (1) and (3) are ST0095's AC-00.1 and (2) is its AC-00.2; 0705's thread carries the same.
